description: The KDE Plasma desktop on Wayland, logged in as the box user at start: the image and its boxes get a screen, shown with box view (Debian and Ubuntu images; Plasma needs polkitd, and the polkit parameter says how it answers)

polkit.description: how polkitd, which Plasma needs, answers a program that asks for a privileged action: deny refuses every request; debian follows the system's own rules (Debian's, or Ubuntu's in an Ubuntu image), so the box user and every program it runs, an agent included, can power the box off and mount disks and disk images without a password. Recipes/README.md says more

steps.name: A polkit choice this recipe knows
steps.run: case "$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT" in deny|debian) echo "polkit=$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT";; *) echo "the polkit parameter is deny or debian, not '$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT'" >&2; exit 1;; esac

steps.name: Plasma, its terminal, file manager and settings, the SDDM login manager, PipeWire and the accessibility bus, without recommended packages (but for the Wayland session, a package of its own on Ubuntu)
steps.run: apt-get -q -y update && session=""; if apt-cache show plasma-session-wayland > /dev/null 2>&1; then session=plasma-session-wayland; fi; apt-get -q -y --no-install-recommends install plasma-desktop sddm konsole dolphin systemsettings pipewire wireplumber xdg-user-dirs at-spi2-core $session

steps.name: polkitd's rules, as the polkit parameter says
steps.run: rules=/etc/polkit-1/rules.d/00-agent-vm.rules; case "$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT" in deny) printf '%s\n' '// agent-vm polkit=deny' 'polkit.addRule(function (action, subject) { return action.id == "org.freedesktop.login1.chvt" ? polkit.Result.YES : polkit.Result.NO; });' > "$rules.new";; debian) printf '%s\n' '// agent-vm polkit=debian' > "$rules.new";; *) echo "the polkit parameter is deny or debian, not '$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT'" >&2; exit 1;; esac && chmod 644 "$rules.new" && mv -f "$rules.new" "$rules"

steps.name: The box user logged in to Plasma at start, with no password
The screen never locks
steps.run: mkdir -p /etc/xdg && printf '%s\n' '[Daemon]' 'Autolock=false' 'LockOnResume=false' > /etc/xdg/kscreenlockerrc && { grep -qx 'action/lock_screen=false' /etc/xdg/kdeglobals 2> /dev/null || printf '%s\n' '' '[KDE Action Restrictions][$i]' 'action/lock_screen=false' >> /etc/xdg/kdeglobals; }

steps.name: The panel's launchers: settings, files and terminal (the software store is not installed)
steps.run: printf '%s\n' '// agent-vm: the panel starts with System Settings, the file manager and the terminal;' '// Discover, the software store it has by default, is not installed.' 'for (const panel of panels()) {' '    for (const widget of panel.widgets()) {' '        if (widget.type === "org.kde.plasma.icontasks" || widget.type === "org.kde.plasma.taskmanager") {' '            widget.currentConfigGroup = ["General"];' '            widget.writeConfig("launchers", ["applications:systemsettings.desktop", "preferred://filemanager", "applications:org.kde.konsole.desktop"]);' '        }' '    }' '}' > /usr/share/plasma/shells/org.kde.plasma.desktop/contents/updates/agent-vm-launchers.js

steps.name: The desktop starts with the system

update.name: polkitd's rules, as the polkit parameter now says
update.run: rules=/etc/polkit-1/rules.d/00-agent-vm.rules; case "$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT" in deny) printf '%s\n' '// agent-vm polkit=deny' 'polkit.addRule(function (action, subject) { return action.id == "org.freedesktop.login1.chvt" ? polkit.Result.YES : polkit.Result.NO; });' > "$rules.new";; debian) printf '%s\n' '// agent-vm polkit=debian' > "$rules.new";; *) echo "the polkit parameter is deny or debian, not '$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT'" >&2; exit 1;; esac && chmod 644 "$rules.new" && mv -f "$rules.new" "$rules"

checks: [ "$(systemctl show -P Id display-manager.service)" = sddm.service ] && echo 'SDDM starts with the system'
[ "$(systemctl get-default)" = graphical.target ] && echo 'the system starts to graphical.target'

grep -qx "User=$(id -un)" /etc/sddm.conf.d/50-agent-vm.conf && grep -qx 'Session=plasma' /etc/sddm.conf.d/50-agent-vm.conf && [ -f /usr/share/wayland-sessions/plasma.desktop ] && echo "$(id -un) is logged in to Plasma at start"
command -v plasmashell > /dev/null && command -v kwin_wayland > /dev/null && echo 'Plasma and KWin are installed'
grep -qx 'Autolock=false' /etc/xdg/kscreenlockerrc && grep -qx 'action/lock_screen=false' /etc/xdg/kdeglobals && echo 'the screen never locks'

pkcheck --action-id org.freedesktop.login1.power-off --process $$ > /dev/null 2>&1; answer=$?; case "$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT:$answer" in deny:1) echo 'polkitd refuses every request (polkit=deny)';; debian:2) echo "polkitd follows the system's own rules (polkit=debian): what they allow the desktop's user, every program of $(id -un) can do";; *) echo "polkit=$AGENT_VM_PARAM_POLKIT, and polkitd answered $answer to a request to power off"; exit 1;; esac
